article.title: SC suspends Imaan, Hadi's sentences in controversial social media posts case, orders their release
article.summary: ISLAMABAD: The Supreme Court on Thursday suspended the sentences of human rights lawyer Imaan Zainab Mazari-Hazir and her spouse, Hadi Ali Chattha, in the controversial social media posts case.The development came as a two-judge SC bench, headed by Justice Naeem Akhtar Afghan and also including Justice Ishtiaq Ibrahim, took up the couple’s appeals against the Islamabad High Court’s (IHC)refusalin February to suspend the sentences.On January 24, an Islamabad sessions courtsentencedImaan and Hadi to a total of 17 years in jail on multiple charges under thePrevention of Electronic Crimes Act(Peca). The convictions of the couple, who had already been jailed the day before in a separate case, werewidelycondemned bylawyersandUnited Nations (UN) experts.On Thursday, the SC granted the couple bail against surety bonds of Rs200,000 and ordered their release pending the IHC’s final verdict.“Both are lawyers and we are keeping their honour,” observed Justice Afghan, but also asked senior couns...

article.title: Pakistan police re-arrest prominent rights lawyer after top court granted bail
article.summary: Pakistani police re-arrested prominent human rights lawyer Imaan Mazari and her husband on Thursday night, hours after the country's top court granted bail and suspended their sentences in a cybercrime case, her lawyer said.

article.title: Imaan, Hadi sent on judicial remand in another case after SC suspends sentences
article.summary: ISLAMABAD: Hours after the Supreme Court suspended the sentences of human rights lawyer Imaan Zainab Mazari-Hazir and her husband, Hadi Ali Chattha, an anti-terrorism court (ATC) rejected police’s request for a 30-day physical remand of the couple and sent them to jail on judicial remand.On January 24, an Islamabad sessions courtsentencedImaan and Hadi to a total of 17 years in jail on multiple charges under thePrevention of Electronic Crimes Act(Peca). The convictions of the couple, who had already been jailed the day before in a separate case, werewidelycondemned bylawyersandUnited Nations (UN) experts.Islamabad ATC Judge Abul Hasnat Muhammad Zulqarnain passed the order after the two accused were produced before the court for a hearing in a case registered against them at Kohsar police station.Soon after their release, Islamabad police personnel, led by the SSP Operations, reached Adiala jail and arrested the two again in connection with the case. article.title: SC grants bail to Imaan Mazari, husband pending IHC decision
article.summary: The Supreme Court on Thursday granted bail to lawyer and rights activist Imaan Mazari and her husband, advocate Hadi Ali Chattha, pending a final decision by the Islamabad High Court on their applications seeking suspension of their sentences.

article.title: Supreme Court suspends sentences of rights lawyer Mazari and husband
article.summary: LAHORE: Supreme Court of Pakistan on Thursday suspended 17-year prison sentences handed to prominent rights lawyer Imaan Mazari and her husband, and ordered them freed on bail, lifting a detention that has been criticised by activists.Mazari, , and her husband Hadi Ali Chattha, also a lawyer, were convicted in January on charges of sending anti-state social media posts.Both have denied the charges.Mazari challenged the conviction in Islamabad High Court and then took her case to the Supreme Court. That top tribunal said it was issuing its ruling on Thursday pending the decision by the lower court, expected within weeks.“I am grateful to the Supreme Court for finally delivering justice to the couple,” said Mazari’s mother, Shireen Mazari, who served as human rights minister under jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan.Social media posts case: IHC says pleas of Imaan, Chattha maintainableThe family was still waiting for the couple to be freed, she told Reuters.Mazari has earned inter...

article.title: Lawyers' body announces boycott of court proceedings in Islamabad on Saturday to protest Imaan, Hadi's rearrest
article.summary: ISLAMABAD: The Islamabad Bar Association (IBA) has announced a boycott of court proceedings in the federal capital for Saturday (September 19) to protest the rearrest of human rights lawyer Imaan Zainab Mazari-Hazir and her husband, Hadi Ali Chattha, after the Supreme Court suspended their sentences and ordered their release on bail.Imaan and Hadi were arrested late on Thursday in a second case after the SC ordered their release in a case pertaining to their posts on social media. The couple was sentenced to 17 years on multiple charges under thePrevention of Electronic Crimes Act(Peca) in the case.However, soon after their release on Thursday, Islamabad police personnel arrested the two outside Adiala jail in connection with another case and produced them before an anti-terrorism court, which sent them to jail on judicial remand.The second case was registered at the federal capital’s Kohsar police station on March 22, 2025 on a complaint by City Magistrate Ghulam Murtaza Chandio.
